title: Who Are You, Alice? — The Elder Eye's Caterpillar
canonPolicy: Ghaunadaur is an established Forgotten Realms deity; the caterpillar appearance, seeing-stone connection and dialogue are original Moonveil homebrew. Attribution of a manifested avatar requires DM approval and timeline verification.

avatar.visual: photorealistic giant pale segmented caterpillar with dark blue-black patterns, an eye-shaped halo, seated on a fungal column above the Pit; uncanny, not cartoon
avatar.rules: No automatic pact, level, item, or divine favor granted

stages.title: The Eye Opens
stages.plane: Material Plane — pending date and map verification
stages.appearance: HOME BREW CATERPILLAR SHAPED PROJECTION; NOT OFFICIAL GHAUNADAUR AVATAR FORM
stages.openingNarration: At the Pit's edge Alice's seeing-stone projects a vast unblinking eye. A caterpillar-shaped silhouette coils around a broken column.

dialogue.speaker: Caterpillar Avatar
dialogue.text: You have walked far, little fallen thing. Tell me: are you the same creature that first dropped through the dark?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: I remember the fall. I do not accept your claim over what followed.

dialogue.speaker: The Caterpillar
dialogue.text: Memory is not ownership. Neither is refusal. Yet both are interesting.

stages.objective: Find the missing eye-shaped keystone before the apparition will answer a second question.
environmentActions: Inspect the lens without touching the ooze
Trace the voice to the stone's far side

choices.text: Request terms openly and protect all witnesses.
Help the vulnerable before answering the riddle.
Reject any demand that Alice surrender her identity.
Study the eye and compare its magic with earlier encounters.
Prepare a defensive spell if the avatar attacks.

stages.title: The Question of Names
stages.plane: Material Plane — pending date and map verification
stages.appearance: HOME BREW CATERPILLAR SHAPED PROJECTION; NOT OFFICIAL GHAUNADAUR AVATAR FORM
stages.openingNarration: A ring of blue-black mushrooms marks a dry island above the ooze.

dialogue.speaker: Caterpillar Avatar
dialogue.text: What is a name when its owner has changed? If you leave yours behind, what shall I call you?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Call me Alice. That is my decision.

dialogue.speaker: The Caterpillar
dialogue.text: A decision is a shell. We shall see what hatches.

stages.objective: Recover three witnesses' accounts of the Pit without surrendering Alice's name.

choices.text: Ask for a lawful witness to establish the truth.
Protect those whose names were erased.
Defy the cult's attempt to rename the captives.
Compare records, runes, and testimony.
Break the mechanism enforcing false identities.

stages.title: Smoke Without Fire
stages.plane: Material Plane — pending date and map verification
stages.appearance: HOME BREW CATERPILLAR SHAPED PROJECTION; NOT OFFICIAL GHAUNADAUR AVATAR FORM
stages.openingNarration: The avatar exhales a dark ribbon that resembles smoke but refuses to rise.

dialogue.speaker: Caterpillar Avatar
dialogue.text: Some doors are locked by fear. Others are locked by what you are willing to forget.

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Then I will remember the people you would erase.

dialogue.speaker: The Caterpillar
dialogue.text: How inconvenient. Memory gives the lost somewhere to return.

choices.text: Negotiate a safe rescue corridor.
Free the captives and provide supplies.
Expose the lie that rescue requires sacrifice.
Inspect vents and map the sealed chamber.
Open the emergency exit while guarding against ooze.

stages.title: The Glass of Possible Selves
stages.plane: Material Plane — pending date and map verification
stages.appearance: HOME BREW CATERPILLAR SHAPED PROJECTION; NOT OFFICIAL GHAUNADAUR AVATAR FORM
stages.openingNarration: The seeing-stone shows three reflections of Alice from incompatible eras.

dialogue.speaker: Caterpillar Avatar
dialogue.text: Which one of these is real? The child who fell, the witch who rose, or the stranger who has yet to arrive?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: None of them can decide for me.

dialogue.speaker: The Caterpillar
dialogue.text: Then you understand the burden of becoming.

stages.objective: Separate an illusion from a verifiable time echo without rewriting campaign chronology.

Help a reflection's apparent victim without altering the timeline.
Refuse the false prophecy and its reward.
Verify the calendar, plane, and Weave incarnation.
Disrupt the hostile illusion if it threatens the party.

stages.title: The Feast of Forgotten Promises
stages.plane: Material Plane — pending date and map verification
stages.appearance: HOME BREW CATERPILLAR SHAPED PROJECTION; NOT OFFICIAL GHAUNADAUR AVATAR FORM
stages.openingNarration: A banquet of polished stones surrounds a starving captive.

dialogue.speaker: Caterpillar Avatar
dialogue.text: A promise can be eaten, Alice. Most mortals discover that too late.

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: A promise is kept through actions, not appetite.

dialogue.speaker: The Caterpillar
dialogue.text: Then feed the one who waits. We shall measure your answer.

choices.text: Document the bargain and reject coercive clauses.

Check food safety and the captive's identity.

stages.title: The Eye and the Door
stages.plane: Material Plane — pending date and map verification
stages.appearance: HOME BREW CATERPILLAR SHAPED PROJECTION; NOT OFFICIAL GHAUNADAUR AVATAR FORM
stages.openingNarration: The avatar stretches across the cavern, each segment framing a different locked gate.

dialogue.speaker: Caterpillar Avatar
dialogue.text: You seek an exit. I offer six. Only one will leave the others unharmed.

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Then I will look for the seventh.

dialogue.speaker: The Caterpillar
dialogue.text: There. That is why I keep asking questions.

choices.text: Insist that no captive be exchanged for passage.
Bring companions together to search for another way.
Challenge the avatar's false dilemma.

stages.title: The Unclaimed Answer
stages.plane: Material Plane — pending date and map verification
stages.appearance: HOME BREW CATERPILLAR SHAPED PROJECTION; NOT OFFICIAL GHAUNADAUR AVATAR FORM
stages.openingNarration: The caterpillar uncoils; the great eye closes without blinking.

dialogue.speaker: Caterpillar Avatar
dialogue.text: One final question. If I gave you power without a price, would you still call it mine?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Power does not decide whom I serve.

dialogue.speaker: The Caterpillar
dialogue.text: Then go. I have not finished wondering about you.
